summary: M0 model-only verdict: CONTAIN @ 0.97. Confirmed account takeover. User received and clicked a payroll phish from typosquat domain aegean-edu.co ("Acil hesap doğrulaması"). Shortly after, authentication originated from 185.220.101.7 (BulwarkHost Ltd, Amsterdam NL — a hosting VPS, not the user's normal Turkcell Manisa ISP LT-2207). The attacker performed MFA fatigue (7 denials then 1 approval) before a successful mail login (mfa_prompt_count 8), then accessed mail, and created an inbox forwarding rule via API to external d.yilmaz.payroll@gmail.com, followed by rapid automated sis access. Credentials phished, MFA bypassed, mail read, exfiltration rule set = confirmed compromise requiring immediate containment (password reset, revoke sessions, remove forwarding rule, MFA re-enroll).
limitations: M0 ablation: Nemotron alone, no tools, no Critic, no Risk Gate, no DQ. Not a product configuration.
